object_type.description: Discriminator so a downstream consumer (Part 2 loader) can tell table vs class objects apart without inspecting shape.

name.description: The AOT table name, e.g. VendTrans. Taken from the root <Name> tag.

xsi_type.description: The i:type attribute value, e.g. AxTableFieldString, AxTableFieldEnum. This is the field's base storage type, distinct from its EDT.

edt.description: Value of <ExtendedDataType> if present, else null. NULL DOES NOT MEAN 'NO TYPE INFO' -- check enum_type before treating a field as untyped. Confirmed real case: VendTrans.TransType has edt=null.

enum_type.description: Value of <EnumType> if present, else null. Some enum fields carry both edt AND enum_type (e.g. VendTrans.Correct: edt='Correct', enum_type='NoYes'). Some carry ONLY enum_type (e.g. VendTrans.TransType: edt=null, enum_type='LedgerTransType'). A parser must check this field before concluding a field has no type information.

constraints.description: A single relation's constraint list may mix 'field' and 'fixed' kind constraints in the same relation. Confirmed real case: VendTrans's DataArea relation has one ConstraintField (LastSettleCompany==id) and one ConstraintRelatedFixed (isVirtual, no field, no value) in the same <Constraints> block.

kind.description: 'field' = AxTableRelationConstraintField (column joins column). 'fixed' = AxTableRelationConstraintRelatedFixed (related column pinned to a literal value, or in some cases no value at all).

field.description: Source-side column name. ALWAYS null when kind='fixed' -- confirmed real case: FactureJourAmountDifference_RU's FactureType_Extern constraint and DataArea's isVirtual_Extern constraint both have no <Field> tag at all.

related_field.description: Target-side column name. Always present for both kinds.

value.description: Present only for kind='fixed' when a <ValueStr> tag exists (e.g. 'FactureType_RU::AmoutDifference'). Confirmed real case: some fixed constraints (isVirtual_Extern) have NEITHER a Field NOR a ValueStr -- the fixed value is implicit/inherited, not explicit in this XML. Do not assume every fixed constraint has a value string.
